title: Recurring mall dreams I had in the late 80’s to early 90’s
content: So I just stumbled across this sub and very glad I did. I’m also finding the synchronicity uncanny since I’ve typically had these dreams around Christmas. It’s been quite sometime since I’ve had this recurring dream, so It’s all a bit tough to remember, but I want to say I had one within the past 8 years, but I first had them when I was in my late adolescence and teen years. My recurring mall dream involves a 3-4 level mall with lots of escalators and small food courts at the ends. The dream is usually very vivid and there’s a strong feeling of nostalgia that occurs during the dream, it’s very euphoric and emotional. It also feels very real, like it’s a place I experienced in perhaps a parallel lifetime. I also find that these dreams tend not to breakdown or devolve into a strange or seemingly unrelated storyline like many of my more vivid dreams tend to do. Additionally these dreams are very lucid, I’m very self aware and feel in control. I recall that the last time I had the dream, I knew exactly how to navigate the mall and I made it a point to see everything. I would say that although I feel lucid and aware that I’m dreaming, the feeling is more that I’m aware I’m experiencing a different reality while my body is asleep. I apologize that this isn’t overly descriptive of what the dream looks like, but I felt that the feelings and perceptions that are experienced are more important to articulate. After decades of having this dream and feeling it was important, I’m just happy to share the experience and to hear that it seems to be something other people have had and are having.
